Committed and pushed as `9a34fbb`.

---

## Report

**T2 decisions:** none. `due.py t2-list` was empty — no event was awaiting a decision, so nothing was decided and nothing was frozen. No freeze commits, no VOID.

**PENDING re-checks — all three unchanged, all three stay PENDING:**

| name | company source | newest item | yfinance | earliest snapshot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AEHR | aehr.com/newsroom | 2026-09-03 (conference) — no FY27 Q1 date | 2026-11-02 15:00 ET, intraday | 2026-10-01 |
| LEVI | Q4 press-release feed | 2026-07-08 16:10 ET (Q2 results) — no Q3 webcast release | 2026-09-30 16:00 | 2026-09-29 |
| APLD | stockpr RSS | 2026-07-27 16:05 ET (Q4 results) — no FY27 Q1 date | 2026-10-08 16:00 | 2026-10-06 |

Both LEVI (~Sep 24 expected) and APLD (~Sep 26 expected) are now at or near the date their own lead time predicts, so an announcement should appear within the next few runs. `investors.aehr.com` does not resolve at all — the newsroom page is AEHR's working source, and AEHR announces only ~7 days ahead.

**What went wrong — this is the finding, and it needs you:**

The pilot has **never gated a single event**. There is no `gate.json`, no `factors.json`, no `decision.json` anywhere under `events/`. Three of the nine confirmed events are already gone:

- **PAYX** — marked `missed_window` at 16:34 ET on Sep 21
- **DRI** and **BB** — both marked `missed_window` at 15:52 ET on Sep 22, three minutes after the window closed

The cause is timing. Scheduled runs are starting late: the gate step ran 13 minutes behind its 19:40 UTC cron on Sep 22, and the 23:00 UTC housekeeping fires ran 2h25m late on Sep 21 and 2h02m late tonight. Separately, the 18:40 and 19:10 UTC fires left **no trace at all** on either day — no commit, no runlog. Two explanations fit and I cannot tell them apart from inside the runner: GitHub dropped those runs, or they ran and `due.py gate` failed under `continue-on-error: true`, which exits green and commits nothing. `gh run list` returns HTTP 403 for this token, so I can't read the run history to settle it.

Also on the record: the Sep 21 housekeeping AI step died on `API Error: 529 Overloaded` with 0 tool calls, which is why that day had no PENDING re-check and no log line until now.

**Six events remain: AIR and JBL (snapshot Mon Sep 28), MU (Tue Sep 29), NKE (Wed Sep 30), PENG (Mon Oct 5).** On the current trend the pilot finishes with zero snapshots. The fix has to come from you — open the Actions tab and check 18:40 and 19:10 UTC on Sep 21 and 22. If those runs are absent, the schedule needs more fires and an earlier first one; if they're present and green, `continue-on-error` is hiding a gate crash. I can't touch it: the workflow guard restores any AI edit to `.github/` and fails the run.
